info.title: API.SH: TikTok Ad Library
info.description: The TikTok Ad Library API from API.SH: public TikTok Ad Library data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost. Advertisers (names and business ids) and ad keywords matching a query in TikToks EU/UK ad library. Use an id as `advertiser_id` on /tiktok/v1/ad-library/search.

get.description:
Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost. The ad librarys "other commercial content": branded content and creator partnerships shown in the EU/UK, 36 per page, with the creator, brands, posting date, view range and video. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tiktok-ad-library-commercial-content

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Creator username (with or without @).

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The creator's country (two-letter code, EU/EEA, UK or CH).

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Look-back window in days (default 365, up to 365; creators mark few posts as commercial, often none in a month).

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: published (default, newest first) or published_asc.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Value of `next_cursor` from the previous page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One ad from TikTok Creative Center's Top Ads by id (from `/tiktok/v1/ad-library/top-ads`) or its Creative Center link: title, brand, industry, objectives, likes, comments, shares, CTR, the countries it ran in, landing page, keywords, source, voice-over flag and the video (cover, duration, size, playable links that expire after a few hours).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tiktok-ad-library-top-ad

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Top ad id (or pass `url`).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Creative Center top ad link (`.../topads/<id>/...`), instead of `id`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The best-performing auction ads from TikTok Creative Center's Top Ads for a country and period, with each ad's title, brand, industry, objective, likes, CTR, video (cover, duration, size, playable video links) and a link to its Creative Center page. Sort by For You, likes, CTR, conversion rate, impressions or 2s/6s view rate; filter by industry, objective, ad language and likes band. Logged out, TikTok shows the first 20 ads of each filter combination (no further pages), so narrow with filters to see others. `total` is TikTok's count for the combination; `available_filters` lists the countries, industries and languages it offers. Video links expire after a few hours.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tiktok-ad-library-top-ads

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country code (default US); see `available_filters.countries`.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Days to rank over: 7, 30 (default) or 180.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Sort: for_you (default), likes, ctr, cvr, impressions, play_2s_rate, play_6s_rate.

parameters.name: industry
parameters.description: Industry ids, comma-separated (11 digits, from `available_filters.industries`), e.g. `25000000000` for Games.

parameters.name: objective
parameters.description: Campaign objectives, comma-separated: traffic, app_installs, conversions, video_views, reach, lead_generation, product_sales, app_promotion.

parameters.name: ad_language
parameters.description: Ad language codes, comma-separated, e.g. `en` or `es,pt`.

parameters.name: likes
parameters.description: Likes percentile band: top_1_20, top_21_40, top_41_60, top_61_80, top_81_100.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.note: Logged out, TikTok shows the first 20 ads of each filter combination; narrow with filters to see others.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
